decision.explanation: Document d2 explicitly states that 'Xenoblade Chronicles X' was released on April 29, 2015 in Japan. Document d3 provides an alternative date (April 9, 2005), but this conflicts with the known release timeline of the Xenoblade series and appears to be an error or misattribution. Since the question asks specifically for the Japanese release date of Xenoblade Chronicles X, and only d2 provides a consistent and plausible date for this title in Japan, it is the only supported answer.
